WITH cfo AS (
  SELECT employee_id, first_name, last_name, job_title
  FROM employees
  WHERE job_title = 'CFO'
), direct_reports AS (
  SELECT
    e.employee_id,
    e.first_name || ' ' || e.last_name AS employee_name,
    e.level,
    sr.total_ctc_inr_lakhs
  FROM employees e
  JOIN cfo c
    ON e.manager_employee_id = c.employee_id
  LEFT JOIN salary_records sr
    ON sr.employee_id = e.employee_id

)
SELECT
  employee_name,
  level,
  total_ctc_inr_lakhs,
  SUM(total_ctc_inr_lakhs) OVER () AS combined_ctc_inr_lakhs
FROM direct_reports
ORDER BY total_ctc_inr_lakhs DESC NULLS LAST, employee_name;
